Players Committee card image of [[Jakku (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' If [Episode VII] Falcon here, Force drain +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakku_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2200c7b114c532d55235838261af5c5b18cc5d2f 2200c7b] (11 May 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
